_comment: Where indoor Garmin activities go. Keys are either a Garmin activity id (one-off) or a Garmin activity type (every activity of that type, e.g. 'indoor_cycling', 'treadmill_running', 'elliptical', 'other'). Value: { machineId, machine, gym, room, gymId, roomId, word }. Outdoor walk/run/ride/hike need no mapping — they post to the generic Outdoor Activities room.
